diagnosis: The Passport strategy attaches activeOrganization to the request based entirely on an x-organization-id header or query parameter without verifying that the authenticated user (req.user) is an active member of that organization. Any authenticated tenant user can switch active organization context and execute multi-tenant queries against competitor organizations.
